resources.string: This app is an AI companion. It is not a real person.
A warm voice companion for the long days and quiet evenings, in Bangla and English.
Your companion is an AI. It will never pretend to be your wife or any real person. It is here to support your real relationship, never to replace it.
The microphone turns on only when you tap it, and you can stop it at any moment. Once voice chat is ready, your speech is sent to Google Gemini only during a conversation you start.
Captions will appear here while you talk.
Stops looping animations. The orb changes color only.
See every orb state. Test tool only.
Test level (set by hand, not real audio)
Add your Gemini API key in Settings to prepare for voice chat.
Key saved on this phone (encrypted). Tap to test or change.
No key yet. Tap to add your Gemini API key.
A key is saved on this phone, encrypted with Android Keystore.
Paste a new key to replace it
The key will be deleted from this phone. Voice chat will stop working until you add a key again.
Connected. Gemini accepted the key, and the selected model is available.
Google rejected the key. Check that you copied the whole key.
This key isn\'t allowed to use the Gemini API. Check the key\'s restrictions in Google AI Studio.
The key works, but this model isn\'t available to it. Choose another model.
The rate limit or free quota is used up. Try again later.
Google\'s server had a problem. Try again in a minute.
The connection timed out. Check your internet and try again.
The key must not contain spaces or line breaks.
That looks too short to be a full API key.
You can create a free key in Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com). A Google AI Pro subscription does not include API usage by itself.
Models whose free tier isn\'t confirmed on Google\'s pricing page are hidden while Free-only mode is on.

Only offers models with a confirmed free tier, and never switches to a paid model by itself. Real billing protection also depends on your Google Cloud project: if billing is never turned on there, you can\'t be charged.

Your key is stored only on this phone, encrypted, excluded from backups, and never written to logs. This screen blocks screenshots. On Google\'s free tier, Google may use what you send to improve its products. Because the key lives in the app, this setup is meant for your personal phone only.

While a conversation is running, your voice is streamed to Google Gemini so the AI can hear and answer you. Nothing is sent when the microphone is off. On Google\'s free tier, Google may use what you send to improve its products. Conversations are not saved in this app.
Tap the orb to stop her speaking
Microphone is on. It pauses while she speaks, to avoid echo. Tap ✕ to stop.
Microphone is on. Speak naturally, and you can interrupt her. Tap ✕ to stop.
Tap the microphone to start talking.
Today: %1$d of %2$d min (counted on this phone)
Captions disappear when the app closes. Nothing is saved.
Add your Gemini API key first.
Microphone permission is needed to talk. You can allow it in the phone\'s app settings.
The microphone could not be opened. Another app may be using it.
Audio is busy (for example, a phone call is in progress).
Gemini rejected the session settings. Try another model in Settings → API key.
The connection was lost. Tap the microphone to start again.
Something went wrong with the conversation.
The session reached its time limit. Tap the microphone to start a new one.
Today\'s conversation budget is used up. You can change it in Settings.
The conversation ended after a quiet moment, to save your free quota.
The conversation stopped because another app needed the audio.
The conversation stopped when you left the app.
Keeps the microphone open while she speaks, so you can cut in. If your phone has no echo cancellation, the app pauses the microphone instead.
These limits help keep you inside the free quota. The minutes are counted on this phone. They are an estimate, not Google\'s billing data.
Stop the conversation on Home to listen to voices.
Each sample is a short Gemini Live session. It uses a few seconds of your free quota and counts toward today\'s budget.
These are style requests in her instructions, not exact controls. Listen to a sample to hear the effect.
Nickname, language, affection, humor, romance and more.
Your phone\'s built-in voice. It works without internet, but it only reads text. It is not the AI. The app uses it to tell you when Gemini can\'t be reached.
This phone has no text-to-speech engine.
The phone voice has no Bangla installed. Add Bangla in the phone\'s text-to-speech settings.
Gemini rejected this voice for the selected model. Try another voice or model.
The sample could not be played.
Leave empty for no nickname. Max 30 characters.

Whatever you choose above, she stays honest. She is an AI, never pretends to be your wife or any real person, never invents shared memories, never shows jealousy, and supports your real relationships. These rules can\'t be turned off.
